title: AdiBhashaa: A Community-Curated Benchmark for Machine Translation into Indian Tribal Languages
audit_findings: Repository code search returned no indexed AdiBhasha match at audit time; this is a reconciliation signal, not proof of absence.
Provider metadata is sufficient to verify dataset identity and a Mundari manifestation path, but not to promote row-level evidence without obtaining and inspecting the exact manifestation.
Provider labels Mundari ISO as unv; MLHKP must not silently normalize this to another code without an explicit language-identity reconciliation.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 supports noncommercial reuse subject to licence terms, but dataset licensing does not itself establish participant consent, community authority, or unrestricted cultural reuse.
The dataset must not be treated as evidence of Munda cultural practices merely because source domains include social or culturally appropriate material.

promotion.reason: Count-neutral audit only. Promote only after deterministic ledger reconciliation and permitted exact-row inspection.

next_actions: Obtain the permitted Mundari CSV manifestation and capture byte size and SHA-256.
Verify exact row count and stable row locators without publishing restricted personal information.
Inspect dataset/paper documentation for translator/validator provenance, consent, variety and locality.
Reconcile provider ISO label unv against MLHKP language-identity policy without silent correction.
Reconcile against MMSC/WEB-MUN and prior Karya/Adi Vaani/parallel-corpus families before controlled identity assignment.
Promote only supported linguistic translation evidence; do not infer cultural practice.
